Subject: Merchant bank reassignment & invoice routing for Redwood services

Hi Monica,

Quick note from AP at Heritage — we're moving our merchant/acquiring relationship to First River Merchant Services starting May 1. As a result, we'd like Redwood to route future invoices / invoice PDFs to our new payables mailbox (ap-firstriver@heritage-sol.com) and update the payment remittance instructions on your invoices to match the attached wire/ACH instructions.

We understand this will touch your billing records and possibly the statement descriptor. Our main asks:
- Update remittance email for PDF invoices to ap-firstriver@heritage-sol.com
- Include the new legal name on invoices: Heritage Solutions LLC (previously Heritage Solutions, Inc.) — the legal name change took effect 2027-04-01
- If you need a signed authorization to change the merchant field or update ACH details on file, please confirm and we'll provide a signed PDF (I attached the draft authorization).

Also, please confirm whether Redwood requires a new W-9 given the legal form change. Heritage is US-based; VAT is not applicable, but we have an updated EIN we can share if required.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Torres
Senior Accounting Manager
Heritage Solutions

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Merchant bank reassignment & invoice routing for Redwood services

Alex — thanks for the heads up and attachments.

Quick confirmation and next steps from our side:
1) Invoice routing: we can set PDF invoice sends to ap-firstriver@heritage-sol.com and add that address to the invoice metadata.
2) Legal name change: we will update the "Bill To" legal name to "Heritage Solutions LLC" in our billing system. We will need a copy of the EIN confirmation or W-9 with the new legal name to keep on file for finance/audit.
3) Authorization: the attached merchant authorization looks good at first pass. Can you confirm the signatory on that PDF is authorized to approve payment-method updates? We'll need an explicit signature name and title — our billing team requires that detail for merchant changes.
4) Timing: we can target the change to go live for invoices issued on or after 2027-05-03. If Heritage needs earlier change for the invoice dated 2027-04-30, let us know and we can do an exception.

Rafael (cc'd) will handle the backend change in our billing ledger and will update our accounting contacts list. Laura, can you log a billing change request and attach the signed authorization + W-9 when we have it?

Two small notes: we try to avoid changing historical invoices; if you want amended copies for pre-May invoices we can reissue with a 0 USD credit line to reflect the new entity — that takes a day. Also, we do not include full bank routing numbers in public invoice metadata; we'll store the bank details in a secure payment instruction field and only expose the last four digits in the invoice PDF footer for verification.

I'll treat this as a priority.

Best,
Monica
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
--Signature: Monica Patel | Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
